top_signals.title: Japanese baseball’s all-time hit king Isao Harimoto dies at 86
top_signals.summary: Harimoto, who finished his career with 3,085 hits and is the only player in NPB history to reach 3,000, died at a Tokyo hospital on Wednesday.
